title: bridge: the tmux boot sends `cd <workingDir>` unquoted, and two pane sends drop their errors into false clean outcomes
summary: Found by comment-reduction bridge groups 3 and 4 (2026-09-26); the console verified (1). (1) internal/bridge/driver_tmux_boot.go:56 sends "cd "+prep.workingDir to the pane's shell unquoted, while the EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT export two lines later uses shellQuotePOSIX. A working dir with a space breaks the cd, so the agent runs in the wrong directory, and shell metacharacters in the path would run as commands. (2) driver_tmux_wait_disposition.go (deliverArtifactNudge) discards the nudge's SendKeys error; a failed send then reads as a clear input line, and the ledger records submit_verified, a false clean result. (3) driver_tmux_wait_interaction.go:23 `envs, _ := w.cursor.Drain()` drops the inbox drain error silently.
fix: Quote the cd target with shellQuotePOSIX, and add a test with a working dir containing a space and a `;`. Propagate the nudge send error into the disposition, so a failed send is not submit_verified. Surface the drain error as a coded WARN.
acceptance: a worktree path with a space and a ';' boots into that directory and runs nothing else (test)
a failed nudge send is never recorded as submit_verified (test)
